newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Ed shuts 1,116 MW Mich. nuke - NRC.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Ed shuts 1,116 MW Mich. nuke - NRC.

text.p: Detroit Edison's 1,116 megawatt (MW) Fermi 2 nuclear power station was shut Tuesday to repair a drywell vacuum breaker that failed to close during restart, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said Thursday.
Because engineers were unable to correct the breaker problem within two hours, the unit was required to be taken off line under NRC guidelines, the federal agency said.
In its daily plant status report, NRC said Fermi 2 could begin restart as early as Friday following repairs.
The Newport, Michigan, unit was last shut September 27 for refueling and maintenance.
Detroit Edison is a subsidiary of DTE Energy Corp.
